message: 流星に願いを？

name: Helena
message: 「They're pretty, aren't they」

name: Helena
message: 「With this many shooting stars falling, don't you think any wish could come true?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Beauty is a mask that hides terror. Those are false shooting stars」

name: Helena
message: 「Of course I know that. To hear you tell it, they're an omen of ruin and despair, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「Even so, a shooting star is a shooting star」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, why not make your wishes at a planetarium? There, you can control their speed, duration, and direction just as you please」

name: Helena
message: 「You're even more matter-of-fact than usual tonight」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I am in no mood to say anything hopeful」

name: Helena
message: 「Did the results come in?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The synchrotron radiation phenomenon caused by spatial distortion--」

name: Helena
message: 「Before that, why don't you at least have some coffee」

name: Melilot
message: 「To be honest, I would prefer black tea」

name: Helena
message: 「Give up on that when I'm the one making it」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am well aware. Then, I shall take you up on your offer」

name: Melilot
message: 「...It is bitter」

name: Helena
message: 「The beans and the way I brewed it are the exact same as always, though」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps it is because I have learned the truth」

name: Helena
message: 「...Is it going to exceed criticality?」

name: Melilot
message: 「According to our observations of the spatial distortion's synchrotron radiation... at the end of December, likely on the day of the Holy Night Festival, Re-Crea will exceed criticality」

name: Helena
message: 「What are the odds of a spatial collapse caused by Pre-Materialize?」

name: Melilot
message: 「At its current progression, 100%. The world will be reduced to Pre-Materia」

name: Helena
message: 「I wish you were a liar」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, I am not very good at lying」

name: Helena
message: 「So in other words, the world is going to end」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heaven, the Human World, and the Demon World will collapse, and this world will end. Only this world, mind you」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, he might somehow manage to do something about it, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「He is not that person. Therefore, I cannot be quite so optimistic」

name: Melilot
message: 「Moreover, this time... that man is on the move. Quite likely the strongest berserker across both Heaven and the Demon World」

name: Helena
message: 「That guy really isn't my type, you know」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your preferences are entirely irrelevant, Helena」

name: Helena
message: 「Can you win?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if I draw him into a place where I have the advantage... twenty percent」

name: Helena
message: 「It's not like you to think about picking a fight without a surefire plan to win」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is simply how things turned out」

name: Helena
message: 「You just don't want to make those kids fight, do you」

name: Melilot
message: 「...It is a matter of probability. I simply have a better chance of winning than they do」
